entries.7178f5a339dbc777: Based on its corporate philosophy of “Contributing to the preservation of the global environment,” the company formulated the “TRE Medium-Term Management Plan 2030” in May 2026. Its basic strategies are “strengthening existing businesses (power to polish),” “challenging new fields and new businesses (power to expand),” and “strengthening the coordination function of the holding company (power to connect).” In business strategy, it presents the demonstration of group synergies and the expansion of the “TRE Environmental Complex Business” concept (Ichihara City, Chiba Prefecture) and the “Soma Circular Park” concept; in management strategy, it presents the promotion of partnership strategies such as M&A and capital and business alliances.
